sql.data: create table attributes (name text); create table MES(name text, attributes text, value text);
select * from MES where value="0" limit 2000
select attributes from MES GROUP by attributes

SELECT st.severity, st.alertTime, st.gateway, st.managedEntity || " > " || st.sampler || " > " || st.dataview || " > " || st.cell as xPath, CASE WHEN st.snoozed=='true' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS s1, (SELECT snoozeAge FROM snooze_table sd WHERE sd.id = st.id) AS snoozeAge, CASE WHEN st.userAssigned=='true' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS a1, (SELECT assignAge FROM assignment_table at WHERE at.id=st.id) AS assignAge FROM severity_table st ORDER BY st.severity ASC, st.alertTime ASC
select *, managedEntity || " > " || sampler || " > " || dataview || " > " || cell AS xPath FROM snooze_table ORDER BY snoozeAge DESC
select *, managedEntity || " > " || sampler || " > " || dataview || " > " || cell AS xPath FROM assignment_table ORDER BY assignAge DESC
SELECT * FROM probe_table pt ORDER BY gateway, probe ASC
SELECT * FROM db_table db ORDER BY gateway ASC
SELECT * FROM analytics_table ORDER BY gateway ASC
SELECT * FROM gwsev_table ORDER BY gateway ASC

SELECT username, COUNT(username) AS connections, userGroups, genericUser, GROUP_CONCAT(gateway) AS gateways, hostname, release, releaseAge FROM connections_table GROUP BY username ORDER BY username ASC
SELECT release, COUNT(release) AS instances, releaseAge FROM probe_table GROUP BY release ORDER BY release DESC

SELECT gateway, warningItems, criticalItems, probeCount, probesUp, maxDataAge, (SELECT dbEnabled FROM db_table db WHERE sv.gateway=db.gateway) AS dbEnabled, (SELECT dbConnection FROM db_table db WHERE sv.gateway=db.gateway) as dbConnection, (SELECT dbCacheFiles FROM db_table db WHERE sv.gateway=db.gateway) as dbCacheFiles, (SELECT analyticsEnabled FROM analytics_table at WHERE sv.gateway=at.gateway) AS analyticsEnabled, (SELECT analyticsConnection FROM analytics_table at WHERE sv.gateway=at.gateway) as analyticsConnection, (SELECT analyticsMessagesDropped FROM analytics_table at WHERE sv.gateway=at.gateway) as analyticsMessagesDropped, (SELECT lastSync FROM gateways_table gw where sv.gateway=gw.gateway) AS lastSync, (SELECT hotStandbyState from gateways_table gw where sv.gateway=gw.gateway) AS hotStandbyState, (SELECT secondaryStatus from gateways_table gw where sv.gateway=gw.gateway) AS secondaryStatus FROM gwsev_table sv ORDER BY gateway ASC
SELECT gateway, changed, applied FROM config_table WHERE isMain=="true" ORDER BY gateway ASC
SELECT gateway, file, changed, applied FROM config_table WHERE isMain=="false" ORDER BY gateway ASC, file ASC

SELECT gt.gateway, gt.connectionStatus, gt.pHost AS primaryHost, gt.sHost AS secondaryHost, gt.port, gt.security, gw.clients, gw.release, gw.releaseAge, gw.licenseDaysRemaining FROM gateways_table gw LEFT JOIN gw_table gt ON gt.gateway=gw.gateway
SELECT release, COUNT(release) AS instances, releaseAge FROM gateways_table GROUP BY release ORDER BY release DESC
